answer: Each operator enrolls one face template, unique as a marble's grain, and supervises at most three agents. Each epoch starts with a 60-second live video check; the network issues a signed attestation valid for that epoch only, and agents whose operator misses the 15-minute window freeze. A random 10% face a second verifier; any mismatch burns a $50 bond and kills all three. Running 100 fakes needs 34 operators at $15, $510 per epoch plus $1,700 of bond at risk, so costs spiral with scale while honest operators pay a minute. Like a garden pruned each epoch, frozen identities never seed.
